source.role: Authoritative ML branch; models below were produced from this branch.

target.name: DailyGeneration_MU
target.description: Next-day / same-date daily generation for a single plant. There is no hourly model in this repository.

quality_policy.weather_sentinel_rule: Weather values <= -900 (-999 is the NASA POWER sentinel) are treated as missing, flagged, then filled per plant with forward-fill followed by backward-fill.
quality_policy.negative_generation_rule: Negative DailyGeneration_MU values are flagged and clipped to 0.0 for modelling. The canonical dataset currently contains zero negatives.
quality_policy.missing_identifier_rule: Rows without Date, PlantName, Type, Capacity_MW or target are dropped and counted.
quality_policy.invalid_capacity_rule: Rows with Capacity_MW <= 0 are dropped and counted.

leakage_rules: All generation lags are computed per plant with shift(lag).
Generation_roll_3 and Generation_roll_7 are computed per plant as shift(1) followed by a 3/7-row rolling mean.
Weather lags are computed per plant with shift(1).
preprocessing.split_definition: For each plant, sort rows by Date. The earliest int(n * 0.80) rows are train; the remaining rows are test. No shuffling and no random seed.

models.preprocessing_required: Build the 25 columns exactly as in scripts/engineer_plant_features.py. No feature scaling is applied for the RF.

inference_contract.requires: One row per plant/date with daily weather and plant-wise lag/rolling features.

serving_blockers: Generation_per_MW = DailyGeneration_MU / Capacity_MW uses the current day's target. It cannot be computed before the generation being predicted is known. The feature is preserved because the committed artifact was trained with it; changing it would invalidate the model.

known_limitations: The committed Random Forest metrics cannot be reproduced because data/final/plant_features_dataset.csv, the exact 25-plant subset and the original _split column are absent from all branches and commits.
The committed LSTM metrics also differ slightly when recomputed on regenerated features; they are reported as committed actuals, not as reproduced values.
The README's 25-plant / 22,764-row dataset statement does not match the canonical 37-plant / 29,369-row dataset; no committed rule reconstructs the 25-plant subset.
The Random Forest uses Generation_per_MW derived from the current-day target and is therefore not safe to serve without retraining or a feature-contract change.
All models predict daily generation. There is no hourly model and no conversion to hourly output.
No backend or API exists in the repository.
